translationRepairs: From the day full mourning was assumed, they went to Shuntian Prefecture to raise lamentation for three days; everything else followed the protocol used at the death of Empress Ma.
From the day full mourning was assumed, they went to Yingtian Prefecture to raise lamentation for three days; everything else followed the protocol used at the death of Empress Ma.
應天府 is Yingtian, not Shuntian.
When the posthumous name was about to be conferred, the emperor personally announced to Heaven and Earth on the cinnabar steps of the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
When the posthumous name was about to be conferred, the emperor personally announced to Heaven and Earth on the cinnabar steps of the Hall of Worshipping Heaven.
奉天殿 is the Fengtian Hall (Hall of Worshipping Heaven), not the Qing-era Hall of Supreme Harmony.

After four bows were completed, the orderlies raised the register-and-seal table to the cinnabar steps of the Hall of Supreme Harmony, placed it in the colored palanquin, went out by the central avenue, entered the Right Shun Gate to the Spirit Table Hall, set the register and seal on the table, and withdrew to wait outside the hall.

After four bows were completed, the orderlies raised the register-and-seal table to the cinnabar steps of the Hall of Worshipping Heaven, placed it in the colored palanquin, went out by the central avenue, entered the Right Shun Gate to the Spirit Table Hall, set the register and seal on the table, and withdrew to wait outside the hall.
奉天殿 is the Fengtian Hall (Hall of Worshipping Heaven), not the Qing-era Hall of Supreme Harmony.
The next day the emperor, in auspicious dress, held court at the Gate of Supreme Harmony, and bells and drums were sounded.
The next day the emperor, in auspicious dress, held court at the Gate of Worshipping Heaven, and bells and drums were sounded.
奉天門 is the Fengtian Gate.
At dawn the emperor went out the North Peace Gate to welcome the coffin; the grand empress dowager and empress waited on the level platform.
At dawn the emperor went out the North Peace Gate to welcome the coffin; the empress dowager and empress waited on the level platform.
皇太后 is the empress dowager, not the grand empress dowager.
From the first mourning through burial, the emperor, the grand empress dowager, the empress, consorts, princesses, and imperial sons all offered sacrifice.
From the first mourning through burial, the emperor, the empress dowager, the empress, consorts, princesses, and imperial sons all offered sacrifice.
皇太后 is the empress dowager.
The memorial was submitted again, and the emperor was ordered to examine the mourning rites for the late Grand Empress Dowager Xiaosu.
The memorial was submitted again, and an order was given to examine the mourning rites for the late Grand Empress Dowager Xiaosu.
命考 is the emperor ordering an examination, not the emperor being ordered.
Four days after the burial, the emperor presided at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; officials performed the consolation rite; and auspicious dress was first adopted.
Four days after the burial, the emperor presided at the Gate of Worshipping Heaven; officials performed the consolation rite; and auspicious dress was first adopted.
奉天門 is the Fengtian Gate.

The ritual official Fang Xianfu also cited chapters such as Ceremonial Rites and Mourning Dress, arguing back and forth, and cited the precedent recorded in Imperial Instructions of Three Reigns that after Empress Renxiao died, the Taizu emperor, after his hemp mourning, still wore white garments and caps for several months.

The ritual official Fang Xianfu also cited chapters such as Ceremonial Rites and Mourning Dress, arguing back and forth, and cited the precedent recorded in Imperial Instructions of Three Reigns that after Empress Renxiao died, the Taizong emperor, after his hemp mourning, still wore white garments and caps for several months.
太宗 is Taizong (the Yongle emperor), not Taizu.

Your servant requests that Your Majesty wear a dark cap and plain dress and preside at the West Corner Gate for ten days, then a dark cap and dark dress at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; when officials enter the Left Flank Gate they should wear black gauze caps and blue garments while attending.

Your servant requests that Your Majesty wear a dark cap and plain dress and preside at the West Corner Gate for ten days, then a dark cap and dark dress at the Gate of Worshipping Heaven; when officials enter the Left Flank Gate they should wear black gauze caps and blue garments while attending.
奉天門 is the Fengtian Gate.

On the appointed day, the emperor in regular dress presides at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; the primary and secondary envoys in regular dress; officials in pale-colored garments and black horn belts enter ranks and perform the rite as in protocol.

On the appointed day, the emperor in regular dress presides at the Gate of Worshipping Heaven; the primary and secondary envoys in regular dress; officials in pale-colored garments and black horn belts enter ranks and perform the rite as in protocol.
奉天門 is the Fengtian Gate.

The emperor in regular dress holds court at the Gate of Supreme Harmony; officials in pale garments; bells, drums, and whip are sounded as usual; on the first and fifteenth he does not ascend the hall.

The emperor in regular dress holds court at the Gate of Worshipping Heaven; officials in pale garments; bells, drums, and whip are sounded as usual; on the first and fifteenth he does not ascend the hall.
奉天門 is the Fengtian Gate.
Lady Du, mother of Emperor Muzong, died in the thirty-third year of his reign.
Lady Du, mother of Emperor Muzong, died in the thirty-third year of the Jiajing reign.
三十三年 here is Jiajing 33 (1554); Muzong had not yet reigned.
The emperor wore light-colored garments and conducted affairs at the Gate of Heavenly Favor; all officials wore light-colored garments, black gauze caps, and black horn belts when attending court.

The emperor wore light-colored garments and conducted affairs at the Gate of Worshipping Heaven; all officials wore light-colored garments, black gauze caps, and black horn belts when attending court.
奉天門 is the Fengtian Gate.
She had no son; Taizu ordered the Prince of Wu, Zhu, to preside over the funeral, wear mourning for a foster mother, and observe cut-edge hemp mourning for three years.
She had no son; Taizu ordered the Prince of Wu, Zhu Su, to preside over the funeral, wear mourning for a foster mother, and observe cut-edge hemp mourning for three years.
吳王橚 is Zhu Su; the personal name was truncated.

Court was suspended for five days; the emperor wore light yellow garments and conducted affairs at the Gate of Heavenly Favor; all officials wore light-colored garments, black gauze caps, and black horn belts when attending court.

Court was suspended for five days; the emperor wore light yellow garments and conducted affairs at the Gate of Worshipping Heaven; all officials wore light-colored garments, black gauze caps, and black horn belts when attending court.
奉天門 is the Fengtian Gate.
